neet_phy_u06_t00_1.working: G = F r^2/(m1 m2). Substituting dimensions: [MLT^-2][L^2]/[M^2] = [M^-1 L^3 T^-2].

neet_phy_u06_t00_2.working: F is proportional to m1 m2/r^2. Tripling one mass and doubling r gives a factor 3/2^2 = 3/4, so F' = 3F/4.

neet_phy_u06_t00_3.working: Each mass feels two forces of magnitude Gm^2/a^2 at 60° to each other. Resultant = 2F cos30° = sqrt(3) Gm^2/a^2.

neet_phy_u06_t00_4.working: Gravity cannot be shielded and is independent of the medium. A metal sheet does not reduce the force, so A is false and R is true.

neet_phy_u06_t00_5.working: Net force anywhere inside a uniform shell is zero, so I is false. By Newton's third law the apple and Earth exert equal and opposite forces on each other, so II is false.
